英文:
The app receives device images over local Wi-Fi. It uses no accounts, advertising, analytics or cloud sync.

Profile names, photos, ear labels, silent videos, known device Wi-Fi details and diagnostic logs are stored on your phone. Android requires permission to read the Wi-Fi list when finding nearby devices. The app does not scan the photo library. It reads only an image you explicitly choose, to crop and save a cover for the active person. Covers stay on your phone. The app does not access GPS, the microphone or Bluetooth.

When you tap Share, Android passes your selected files to the app you choose. You can delete files from the gallery. Clearing app data or uninstalling removes its local data. Recipients control copies you have already shared.

For privacy questions or feedback, contact GitHub @foreverfine77.
